quests.title: Name the block to one person at work
quests.description: You have zero WORK reps in 7 days and your sentry shows task avoidance there. Today, identify one thing at work you're stuck on or avoiding, and tell a colleague or supervisor — out loud or in a direct message — what specifically you don't understand or need help with. Not a polished question. The raw version: 'I'm stuck on X and I don't know Y.' Screenshot the message or log the conversation.
quests.schema_target: inadequacy — the belief that admitting confusion at work proves you're not enough, so you perform understanding instead of requesting help, which keeps you isolated and avoidant in the one lane you're completely dodging
quests.rationale: WORK is a fully avoided lane for 7+ days, your own notes describe pretending to understand things you don't, and the inadequacy schema thrives on never letting anyone at work see the gap between what you know and what you don't — asking directly collapses that.
quests.evidence_note: Sent email asking for an assessment on testing requirements.

quests.title: Call, don't text
quests.description: Call one person today — not a text, not an email, a voice call. Someone non-transactional: not a business, not a service provider. Talk for at least 2 minutes. Log who you called and one thing they said.
quests.schema_target: lone-wolf enforcement — your sentry caught it: you named the bias yourself ('I don't need to talk to other people'). The MINIMIZER reframes isolation as self-sufficiency. A voice call strips away the buffer that texting provides and forces real-time social presence.
quests.rationale: You have zero SOCIAL reps in 7 days, you identified your own resistance to human contact in your last sentry entry, and every social quest so far has been text-based — a phone call raises the stakes from asynchronous safety to live vulnerability.

quests.title: Make the specific ask out loud
quests.description: Call or voice-message one person and ask them for something specific you actually need — a favor, advice on a real problem, help with a task. Not text. Your actual voice. The ask must contain the word 'need' or 'help.' Log what you asked and who you asked.

quests.rationale: You've broken the SOCIAL seal via text messages but zero reps use your voice making a direct request — the old map allows written asks because you can polish them, but speaking a need out loud with no edit button is where the real prediction error lives.
